categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including detailed information about land parcels, owners, property extents, and title classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on property ownership and land registration, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
